subtopic: Euler Form, De Moivre's Theorem & Roots of a Complex Number
title: Worked (JEE Advanced): the cubic-sum identity

board_content.text: Evaluate for $a=1,\ b=2,\ c=3$ using the standard factorization.
The $\omega$-factorization gives the same product as three complex linear factors.
Real answer, complex tools — the factors pair up to stay real.

segments_english.text: Here is how the omega factorization delivers a concrete number for the classic cubic-sum expression.
Evaluate a cubed plus b cubed plus c cubed minus three a b c, for a equals one, b equals two, c equals three.
The standard real factorization is a plus b plus c, times a squared plus b squared plus c squared minus a b minus b c minus c a.
The first factor, a plus b plus c, is one plus two plus three, which is six.
The second factor: a squared plus b squared plus c squared is one plus four plus nine, fourteen; and a b plus b c plus c a is two plus six plus three, eleven. Fourteen minus eleven is three.
So the value is six times three, which is eighteen.
The omega version factors the very same expression into three complex linear factors, a plus b plus c, times the two omega-mixtures, and it produces exactly the same product.
That's the elegance: a real answer emerges from complex tools, because the complex factors pair up so that the imaginary parts cancel perfectly.

segments_hinglish.text: Ye raha kaise omega factorization classic cubic-sum expression ke liye ek concrete number deta hai.
Evaluate karo a cubed plus b cubed plus c cubed minus three a b c, a equals one, b equals two, c equals three ke liye.
Standard real factorization hai a plus b plus c, times a squared plus b squared plus c squared minus a b minus b c minus c a.
Pehla factor, a plus b plus c, hai one plus two plus three, jo hai six.
Doosra factor: a squared plus b squared plus c squared hai one plus four plus nine, fourteen; aur a b plus b c plus c a hai two plus six plus three, eleven. Fourteen minus eleven hai three.
To value hai six times three, jo hai eighteen.
Omega version usi expression ko teen complex linear factors mein factor karta hai, a plus b plus c, times do omega-mixtures, aur wo bilkul wahi product deta hai.
Yehi elegance hai: ek real answer complex tools se nikalta hai, kyunki complex factors aise pair up karte hain ki imaginary parts perfectly cancel ho jaate hain.
